SHOWDOWN

GEN 5 DRAFT · VS HILDA

HOW THE DRAFT WORKS

  1. In the lobby, under Format, a new Mode row: Random like today, or Draft. You challenge someone (or the CPU) as usual; the challenge says “Gen 5 Draft”. The ready room and the 3-second countdown don't change.
  2. The server rolls a pool of 16 random-battle Pokémon of that generation, each with its set already fixed (moves, ability, item, level).
  3. Picks go in a snake: 1 · 2 2 · 1 1 · 2 2 · … so whoever picks second gets two in a row. 12 picks, 6 each, 4 left over.
  4. 30 seconds per pick. Tap a Pokémon to see its set on the top screen, then PICK!. Time out = a random pick for you.
  5. When both teams are full you see the other team (like team preview) and choose your lead. Then the battle starts as usual.
  6. Against the CPU it works too: the CPU picks the strongest set left.

Try it: you're player 1. Tap a card, read the set on top, press PICK!. Hilda answers by herself. After 12 picks it moves to choosing the lead.
